title: CiudadActualizada v1
description: A city of the catalog was created, changed or deleted. Published by twa-flights-catalog (CityEventRelay) from flights.catalog_outbox in the exchange topic catalog.events with the routing key catalog.ciudad-actualizada.v1. The AMQP properties repeat eventId (message_id), eventType (type) and eventVersion (header eventVersion). Delivery is at least once: the consumer discards a repeated eventId and an event with a sequence lower than or equal to the last one applied for the same cityId. A new major version is a new routing key (v2) and a new schema; v1 only gets optional fields.

eventId.description: Unique id of the message. It is derived from the id of the outbox (UUID v3 of 'catalog_outbox:<id>'), so a republished event has the same eventId

occurredAt.description: When the change was written in flights.catalog_outbox (UTC)

sequence.description: Id of the event in flights.catalog_outbox. It grows with every change, so it orders the events of the same city

operation.description: UPSERT: the city exists with the data of city. DELETE: the city with cityId does not exist anymore

cityId.description: Id of the city in the catalog (the key of the replica)

city.description: Same JSON as GET /cities/{code} of the catalog service (microcks/catalog-openapi.json). In a DELETE only the code

timeZone.description: IANA id of the time zone, never an offset

country.description: The country when the event is published. Null if the country does not exist in the catalog
